{{Top}}
An '''astronomer''' studied the science of celestial objects and phenomena called '''astronomy'''. They discovered new [[Star/Legends|stars]], [[Planet/Legends|planets]], [[Supernova/Legends|supernovas]], and mapped [[Constellation/Legends|constellations]]. It was usually regarded as a lifelong occupation for people who spent their entire lives on only one planet.

The bright skies of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] prevented amateur astronomers from studying space from that planet.

Astronomy was a subject taught at many schools across the galaxy, including the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] where [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] learned it. Astronomy was among one of many subjects that [[DJ-88]] taught [[Ken]].

An astronomer on [[Tamban]] first "discovered" the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], and named it after [[Aitro Koornacht]].
